This '''kidnap attempt''' was orchestrated by [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. She organized several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Oln Pressig]], one of [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s Security Chiefs, to attack Fel in his quarters of the [[Galactic Empire Embassy]] Complex on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Fel managed to defend himself against the attacking [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and fired several times into the ceiling, setting off an alarm and accidentally shooting his [[Unidentified deputy minister of trade|deputy minister of trade]] in the foot. The attempt having failed, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] managed to trace it back to Treen. Treen then formed an alliance with Lecerson in a conspiracy to unite the Imperial Remnant with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] before ousting [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and taking her place.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This kidnapping attempt first appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', the fourth novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. Although this event was initially labeled as a kidnapping attempt, it is often referred to as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt throughout the novel.
